title: Kan mapping simplicial sets are Kan
statement: Let $Z$ be a Kan complex and let $K$ be any simplicial set in the same universe. With the internal functor simplicial set $\operatorname{Fun}(K,Z)$ defined in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], $\operatorname{Fun}(K,Z)$ is a Kan complex.

source.place: Kerodon Corollary 3.1.3.4 (Tag 00TN): if $Z$ is Kan and $K$ is arbitrary, $\operatorname{Fun}(K,Z)$ is Kan.
